messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: NovaLens has a soft launch in APAC in ~8h. They asked for: allowlist of two IPs, a short QPS lift for a 2.5h window, region pin to ap-southeast-1, and a check-in on renewal risk if launch has degraded performance. Can NetOps + SRE support?
Ravi (NetOps): Yes. Need account id, exact IPs (CIDR vs single), UTC window, desired QPS, and autorevoke TTL. Also confirm whether failover is required.
Maya (CS): Account `novalens-prod-7`. IPs: `198.51.100.23`, `198.51.100.24` (singles). Window: 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-10T04:30:00Z. QPS from 200 -> 900. Autorevoke at +90m after window end (so 2026-04-10T06:00:00Z). No automatic failover, manual only.
Ravi (NetOps): Got it. Opening CFG ticket and will stage rollout canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Implementing ipset entries and rate override with TTL.
cli-bot: Created CFG-8120 for novalens-prod-7 (allowlist + qps + region pin). ETA ~12m.
Ivy (SRE): I'll add a short synthetic and dashboard tile. Rollback rules: p95>1500ms or 5xx>1.5% sustained >90s. I'll post alerts to #incidents and tag on-call.
Maya (CS): AM Omar will be on the post-launch call and will prep a renewal contingency note. Omar, can you join?
Omar (AM): Yes, I'll be there. If we do see issues I'll propose a 2-week burst credit to smooth renewal conversations.
Ravi (NetOps): Canary applied -> allowlist entries added: 198.51.100.23, 198.51.100.24. Rate override active on canary. Autorevoke set 2026-04-10T06:00:00Z.
Ivy (SRE): Canary metrics: 200 OK, p50 140ms, p95 410ms, 5xx 0.0%. Promoting to 50%.
Ravi (NetOps): 50% -> 100% rollout completed. CFG-8120 closed. Logs: ```
ALLOWLIST ADD novalens-prod-7 198.51.100.23
ALLOWLIST ADD novalens-prod-7 198.51.100.24
RATE_OVERRIDE SET novalens-prod-7 900 QPS window 2026-04-10T02:00Z/2026-04-10T04:30Z AUTOREVOKE 2026-04-10T06:00Z
REGION_PIN SET novalens-prod-7 ap-southeast-1
```
Maya (CS): Launch successful. Adding note to the account timeline and sending runbook to the PM. :tada:
Omar (AM): I'll follow up with the customer in 48h for onboarding feedback and to surface the renewal conversation.
Maya (CS): Closing thread. Action: add 1-question CSAT to the account timeline to capture launch experience.
